name: M0 — Mobile status audit document (current state of mobile mode)
description:
OBJECTIVE
Write the audit of the CURRENT mobile mode of the codx-junior web client (Vue 3 + Vuex + vue-router 5 + daisyUI 5/Tailwind 4 + dockview-vue). It is the baseline document of the "Mobile Refactor" board.

OUTPUT FILE
docs/mobile/mobile-current-status.md (create the folder if missing). Stable section structure so later updates can be diffed.

REQUIRED SECTIONS
1. Executive summary (max 10 lines): what breaks on a phone today, the user impact, the 3 root causes.
2. Module & route inventory table for EVERY app: appKey, title, route name + path, resolved component, desktop mode (dockview panel?) vs single mode (route?), mobile status (OK / degrades / broken / unknown). Build it from src/config/apps.js, src/router/index.ts and src/config/appComponentsMap.js, and flag every mismatch between the three (app key without a registered route, route whose component is missing, key only in the component map...).
3. Navigation model today: mode derived from the route (isDesktopMode() === route name 'codx-junior-split'), config/apps.js registry + router/navigate.js openApp(), AppRouteView.vue resolution (meta.app), and the in-memory payload hand-off setPendingParams/getPendingParams.
4. Shell audit: src/App.vue, src/components/desktop/DesktopSidebar.vue, src/components/desktop/Desktop.vue, src/main.ts, index.html.
5. Per-screen consistency audit for the 10 heaviest screens (ChatView/Chat, KanbanBoardView, GlobalSettings, ProjectSettings, KnowledgeView, VibeCodingView, TeamView, InfraView, FileExplorerPanel, ManagementDashboardView): own header? own sidebar/drawer? own scroll container? works at 375 px? has a way back?
6. Defect list with file evidence, severity (blocker/high/medium/low) and one-line fix direction. Verify each of these before writing it:
   D1 Two conflicting definitions of "mobile": src/store/ui.js handleResize (width <= 1024) vs src/App.vue (window.innerWidth < 768) vs src/components/chat/ProfileDrawer.vue (< 1024). Describe what happens in the 768-1024 band.
   D2 No visible global navigation on mobile: App.vue collapses the sidebar on every route change and the only expand controls live inside the off-canvas panel (translateX(-100%)).
   D3 No mobile chrome: App.vue renders <RouterView/> with no app bar, title, back button or bottom navigation; each screen invents its own.
   D4 Mode comes from the route, not the device: opening .../desktop on a phone mounts the dockview workspace.
   D5 Rich payloads travel in memory (setPendingParams): refresh, back-forward or a shared link loses chat/team/channel/workspace/member and screens receive undefined.
   D6 src/components/ChatEntry.vue imports and renders ./ChatEntryMobile.vue, which does not exist in the repository (confirmed by search) -> mobile chat rendering is broken / build-blocking.
   D7 Orphan and legacy mobile code: src/components/mobile/MenuBar.vue (renders <ProjectSelector>, <Notifications>, <UserMenu> without importing them, referenced nowhere); views/HomeMobile.vue referenced by an older App.vue and absent; SplitView.vue/Splitter.vue no longer mounted by the router.
   D8 Registry bypass: legacy $ui.showApp({component}) call sites in src/store/ui.js (e.g. openMediaLibrary with the field typos tgabId / compotabIdnent) never go through config/apps.js, so they cannot work in route (mobile) mode.
   D9 No shared mobile primitives: no page header/back component, no bottom nav, no safe-area-inset handling, no scroll-lock, body{overflow:hidden} + h-full assumptions, inconsistent touch targets.
7. Duplication map: mobile/desktop pairs and duplicated content blocks (GlobalSettings desktop aside vs mobile drawer with 10 duplicated v-if branches, ChatEntry vs ChatEntryMobile, per-screen toolbars).
8. Constraints & risks for the refactor (dockview is desktop-only, deep links and the /:projectName prefix must keep working, layouts persisted in localStorage, eruda hook in main.ts).
9. Annex: target principles (one navigation model, one page chrome component, one viewport source of truth). Max 1 page, no code.

RULES
- No code changes. Documentation only. Cite file paths (line numbers when useful) for every claim.
- If a described defect no longer reproduces, write "already fixed" instead of copying it.
- Markdown tables.

ACCEPTANCE
- The file exists with the 9 sections, every app from config/apps.js appears in the inventory, and each defect has file evidence + severity.
- The reply lists: file path, modules inventoried, defects by severity, the 3 root causes.

messages.content: Produce the mobile status audit for the codx-junior web client and write it to docs/mobile/mobile-current-status.md, following the 9 required sections in the description. Verify every claim against the code before writing it.
